About the project

A polished front end on a simple MVC foundation.

Fieldnotes is a portfolio-ready ASP.NET Core project that demonstrates controller routing, Razor-rendered pages, shared layouts, static assets, and environment-aware error handling.

01

What works now

A responsive stories page, an About page, a real privacy statement, reusable navigation and footer, accessible focus styles, and the standard production error route.

02

How it is built

.NET 10 and ASP.NET Core MVC handle requests and routing. Controllers select Razor views, while a shared layout and one custom stylesheet create a consistent interface.

03

What comes next

Real post models, Entity Framework Core persistence, create/edit workflows, authentication, categories, search, comments, and tests.
